headline: Sheinbaum and Trump meet at APEC; agree on new talks at G20
summary: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum said she agreed with US President Donald Trump to hold a new meeting at the next G20 summit in Mar-a-Lago, Florida. The talks took place at APEC.
why: Bilateral relations between Mexico and the US influence trade policy, tariffs and investment flows across North America.
original_headline: Sheinbaum y Trump se reunen en la APEC; acuerdan nueva charla en el G20
